description.value: A 15-site riverside campground on the Atnarko River within Tweedsmuir South Provincial Park, set in a steep mountain valley along Highway 20; the site is best known for fall salmon runs that concentrate grizzly bears, making it a wildlife-watching anchor rather than a simple overnight stop.

The phone number and email are OSM-only and cannot be corroborated from the fetched website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, fee-based campground with 15 sites within Tweedsmuir South Provincial Park on the Highway 20 touring corridor — a legitimate and useful stop for cycling tourists.
